1-s3.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 1, с. 3. Напиши, что ты любишь делать летом и осенью и чего не любишь делать зимой и весной.
steps: Модель: In … I like to … / In … I don't like to …
In summer I like to ride a bike, swim and dive. In autumn I like to walk in the park.
In winter I don't like to stay at home. In spring I don't like to walk in the rain.
1-s3.answer: In summer I like to ride a bike and swim. In autumn I like to walk in the park. In winter I don't like to stay at home. In spring I don't like to walk in the rain.

2-s3.condition: Unit 1, Section 1, упр. 2, с. 3. Составь вопросы из слов и ответь на них.
steps: What do you like to do in autumn? — I like to walk in the park.
Where do you skate in winter? — I skate on the skating rink.
When do you ride your bike? — I ride my bike in summer.
Can you play tennis? — Yes, I can.
Have you got a football? — Yes, I have.
2-s3.answer: What do you like to do in autumn? Where do you skate in winter? When do you ride your bike? Can you play tennis? Have you got a football? — ответы: I like to walk in the park; on the skating rink; in summer; Yes, I can; Yes, I have.

steps: снежная зима — a snowy winter; жаркое лето — a hot summer; тёплая весна — a warm spring; холодная осень — a cold autumn.
Тепло, но ветрено. — It's warm but windy. Холодно и дождливо. — It's cold and rainy.
4-s4.answer: a snowy winter, a hot summer, a warm spring, a cold autumn; It's warm but windy. It's cold and rainy.

5-s4.condition: Unit 1, Section 2, упр. 5, с. 4. Составь предложения из слов (Future Simple).
steps: Порядок: подлежащее + will + глагол + дополнение + время.
I will play badminton tomorrow. He will ride a scooter next summer. She will swim in the river next summer.
We will make a snowman next winter. You will walk in the park tomorrow. They will play snowballs next winter.
5-s4.answer: I will play badminton tomorrow. He will ride a scooter next summer. She will swim in the river next summer. We will make a snowman next winter. You will walk in the park tomorrow. They will play snowballs next winter.

steps: Указатели: twice a week → Present Simple; next week, tomorrow → Future Simple; today → Present.
1. play; 2. will get; 3. won't be; 4. is; 5. Will you go — Yes, I will.
6-s4.answer: play, will get, won't be, is, Will you go / will

7-s5.condition: Unit 1, Section 2, упр. 7, с. 5. Прочитай письмо Джека и сделай его короче: замени подчёркнутые предложения краткими формами.
steps: Краткие формы: I am → I'm, do not → don't, have got → 've got, they are → they're, does not → doesn't, will → 'll.
I'm kind. I don't live in London. I've got two true friends. They're a donkey and a cat. The donkey doesn't like winter. It'll be sunny. It'll be rainy. I'll be happy to see you.
7-s5.answer: I'm kind. I don't live in London. I've got two true friends. They're a donkey and a cat. The donkey doesn't like winter. It'll be sunny. It'll be rainy. I'll be happy to see you.

steps: Структура письма: адрес и дата → обращение → благодарность за письмо → ответы на вопросы → подпись.
Moscow, Russia. 5th November. Dear Jane, thank you for your letter. My name is Kate. I live in Moscow.
I like Sundays too, because I can do many things: draw pictures, watch TV, play computer games and walk my dog in the park. Best wishes, Kate.
